mapper.select: SELECT employee_id AS employeeId, employee_num AS employeeNum, password AS password FROM employee WHERE employee_num = #{employeeNum}
SELECT r.role_code FROM employee_role er JOIN role r ON er.role_id = r.role_id WHERE er.employee_id = #{employeeId}

SELECT e.employee_id AS employeeId, e.employee_name AS employeeName, e.email AS email, o.org_name AS orgName, r.rank_name AS rankName, p.position_name AS positionName, j.job_name AS jobName FROM employee e LEFT JOIN employee_hr_info hr ON hr.employee_id = e.employee_id LEFT JOIN organization o ON o.org_id = hr.org_id LEFT JOIN `rank` r ON r.rank_id = hr.rank_id LEFT JOIN `position` p ON p.position_id = hr.position_id LEFT JOIN job j ON j.job_id = hr.job_id WHERE e.employee_id = #{employeeId}
